title: Creamy chicken with mushrooms and onion (inferred from training video)
source: original_uncut.mp4, 00:00–36:18; verified using the rotated episode clips
ingredients: cream or a similar pale dairy liquid
limitations: Quantities, exact dairy product, heat settings and seasoning amounts are not established.
The recording ends with the pan covered, without a serving or doneness check.
One relevant pan and one portion of each ingredient are assumed.

steps.instruction: Finish slicing the mushrooms and collect them on the plate.
Chop the onion and set it aside in a bowl.
Finish cutting the chicken into pieces.
Add oil to the pan and heat it; confirm when ready to cook.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pan.
Cook and stir the mushrooms; confirm when ready to add the onion.
Add the chopped onion to the mushrooms.
Stir and cook the onion with the mushrooms; confirm when ready for the chicken.
Add the chicken pieces to the pan.
Cook and turn the chicken with the vegetables. Confirm before adding cream; surface appearance does not establish doneness.
Add the cream and stir it into the pan contents.
Cover the pan with its lid.
Continue cooking under the lid; confirm when you want to open it and stir.
Remove the lid to check and stir the contents.
Stir the chicken, mushrooms and sauce; confirm before covering again.
Cover the pan again to continue cooking.
Check chicken doneness with a food thermometer before serving. The recording does not show this final check.
